$doc: The loop's driver — machine-readable on purpose: readiness, batches, and
cap breaches are computed by schedule.mjs, never by eye. Append-mostly:
never delete a ticket; mark it done or decomposed.
status: todo | in-progress | done | blocked | decomposed ('ready' is computed).
files is a CONTRACT: the verifier diffs the branch and fails undeclared
touches (package.json + lockfiles allowlisted for every ticket).
attempts is the durable diagnosis log. evidence holds the INDEPENDENT
re-verify's output, not the builder's claim.
BROWNFIELD NOTE: v0.1 core pre-exists this loop (ledger [0002]). Tickets
S101+ build on it; none may alter src/ semantics (oracle: scope tripwire).
Acceptance sharpened by 2-agent red-team at intake (ledger [0004]).

tickets.title: Story validator: screenshot-based choreography checks for any scrolly HTML file
tickets.context: Read README.md (contract tables), SPEC.md §5 + §14, test/semantics.test.js (puppeteer-core patterns, Chrome path). Build `node test/validate-story.mjs <file.html> [--tier1]` printing a JSON report and exiting 0/1. RED-TEAM-HARDENED DESIGN REQUIREMENTS (non-negotiable): (1) distinctGraphicStates is SCREENSHOT-BASED — at each step's trigger position take a viewport screenshot of the story region and compare hashes; states are distinct only if pixels differ beyond a small threshold. This covers canvas graphics automatically and rejects invisible/occluded attribute toggles. (2) glueTier via RUNTIME INSTRUMENTATION, not text grep: before any page script runs (evaluateOnNewDocument), wrap EventTarget.prototype.addEventListener (flag scroll/wheel/touchstart/touchmove), onwheel/onscroll property setters, window.IntersectionObserver construction, and Element.prototype.getBoundingClientRect; attribute each call to lib vs author via Error().stack correlation with script order — AND the lib script block must be byte-identical to src/scrolly.js (read from disk), else the ENTIRE block counts as author code. tier1 = zero author calls flagged AND author scripts contain only Scrolly.init statement(s) (AST-light check acceptable: strip comments/strings first). tier2 = no flagged calls. else fail, with the specific flagged API named in the report. Words like 'wheel' in comments/strings must NOT trip it. (3) externalUrls: network-request interception is the authority (page.on('request'), anything not file:// on the fixture's own path), plus a secondary source scan matching (https?:)?// in src/href/xlink:href/srcset/CSS url(). (4) consoleErrors: attach console/pageerror/unhandledrejection listeners BEFORE goto; dwell ≥300ms after each scroll position. (5) bidirectionalConsistent: record state (screenshot hash + data-active-step + is-shown set) at each step top-to-bottom, then bottom-to-top, then a NON-MONOTONIC jump order (last→second→last→first); every revisit must match the first visit. (6) Multi-story pages: per-story reports keyed by root index/id; overall exit is the AND of all stories. (7) No fixture-name special-casing: the validator source must not reference fixture filenames. Exit-0 thresholds per story: stepCount>=4, distinctGraphicStates>=4, glueTier ok, no externalUrls, no consoleErrors, bidirectionalConsistent. Craft the broken/clean fixtures named in files (self-contained, lib inlined byte-identical from src/): dead-steps (4 steps, class churn but pixel-identical graphic), external-url (an https:// img AND a protocol-relative //cdn ref), scroll-jack (plain addEventListener('wheel')), scroll-jack-obfuscated (window['addEventListener']('whe'+'el',...) or onwheel= assignment), asymmetric-state (author stepenter draw that accumulates instead of drawing full state — passes everything except bidirectional), runtime-error (author JS throws after load), fetch-external (URL only constructed at runtime via fetch('ht'+'tps://...')), and fixtures-clean/wheel-in-comment (tier-2-clean page whose author script merely CONTAINS the word wheel in a comment — must PASS). test/validator.test.js asserts every contrast pair below, and runs each broken fixture from a COPY at a randomized temp filename (no name sniffing). If this ticket proves bigger than one session, return tooBig with a proposed split (e.g. core driver / instrumentation / fixtures+tests) rather than half-building.
tickets.acceptance:
- `node test/validate-story.mjs index.html` → exit 0, JSON report with all specified fields
- dead-steps → exit 1, report's failure reasons include distinctGraphicStates<4 and do NOT include glueTier/externalUrls failures (exclusivity)
- external-url → exit 1 listing BOTH the https:// and the protocol-relative URL; no other failure reasons
- fetch-external → exit 1 with the intercepted request URL listed (proves real network interception, not source regex)
- scroll-jack AND scroll-jack-obfuscated → exit 1, glueTier=fail naming the flagged API; no other failure reasons
- fixtures-clean/wheel-in-comment → exit 0 (comment/string mentions must not trip instrumentation)
- asymmetric-state → exit 1 solely for bidirectionalConsistent=false
- runtime-error → exit 1 solely for consoleErrors non-empty
- `grep -E 'dead-steps|external-url|scroll-jack|asymmetric|runtime-error|fetch-external' test/validate-story.mjs` → no matches (no fixture sniffing)
- validator.test.js runs every broken fixture via randomized-temp-filename copies and asserts the exact failure reason per case
- `bun test` green
tickets.evidence: Independent verify (workflow wf_d6471f1e-2ce): verified=true, no regression, no out-of-scope, no gaming. Coordinator gate on merged tree d057805: bun test 45 pass/5 files; validate-story index exit 0; all 7 broken fixtures fail for exactly their one reason (dead-steps:distinctGraphicStates<4, external-url:externalUrls, fetch-external:externalUrls via interception, scroll-jack+obfuscated:glueTier fail naming addEventListener(wheel), asymmetric:bidirectionalConsistent, runtime-error:consoleErrors); clean fixture exit 0; fixture-name grep 0. Commit bca6566 (merge of ticket/S101 b2355e5).

tickets.title: Tier-1 example: stepped chart build (What's-Warming-the-World choreography)
tickets.context: Read README.md, docs/recipes.md (stepped chart + chapter theming), index.html (lib-inlining reference), SPEC.md §14. Single self-contained page: inline-SVG line chart, 6 factor-series over a shared time axis (hand-written path data; each series must be visually distinct and non-degenerate — real curve shapes, not flat lines), side-right story, 6+ steps. Each step reveals/highlights exactly one more series via data-show on SVG groups + [data-active-step] CSS: past series visibly dimmed (opacity/stroke), active series emphasized, per-step annotation callouts. Chapter theming REQUIRED: a page-level --accent custom property changes per step and is consumed visibly (headings/annotations). ONLY author JS: Scrolly.init(). Lib JS+CSS inlined byte-identical from src/. Prose: real sentences, ≥25 words per step, no two steps sharing a sentence — gallery quality (final publish-worthiness is a human gate, but lorem/duplicate text fails mechanically).
tickets.acceptance:
- `node test/validate-story.mjs examples/warming-world.html --tier1` → exit 0, stepCount>=6, distinctGraphicStates>=6
- behavioral (in verify, puppeteer): at step 4, computed opacity of a step-1 series group is < 0.6× the active series group's opacity (past-dimming is real)
- computed value of --accent on the story root differs across ≥3 different data-active-step values
- every series path's bounding box has height > 5% of the chart height (no degenerate flat lines)
- each step's visible prose ≥25 words; no sentence appears in two steps (mechanical text scan)
- inlined lib block byte-identical to src/scrolly.js (extract+diff)
- `bun test` green
tickets.evidence: Verify: verified=true clean. Gate (wf_9d57f68d-b17) + coordinator spot-check: validate-story --tier1 exit 0 (stepCount=6, distinctGraphicStates=6, tier1, bidirectional ok); opacity-dim 0.32<0.6; 6 distinct --accent values; series bboxes >5%; prose floors met; lib byte-identical. Merge a473293.

tickets.title: Tier-2 example: imperative dot re-draw per step, bidirectional + non-monotonic safe (Black-Boys choreography)
tickets.origin: SPEC §14 Tier 2 (NYT Upshot 2018; §13.2 scrollama-port pattern); sharpened per red-team (ledger [0004])
tickets.context: Read README.md (JS API), docs/recipes.md (idempotent full-state draws), SPEC.md §14 Tier-2 budget. Single self-contained page: ~200 dots (SVG or canvas) regrouping/recoloring per step (e.g. flowing between outcome columns), positions from an inline seeded PRNG (mulberry32 with a FIXED literal seed — two page loads must render identically). Driven ONLY by story.on('stepenter') with PURE full-state draw functions: given a step id, draw everything from scratch — no accumulation, no direction branching. Movement may animate (CSS transitions/rAF tween) but END states must be deterministic per step. Author JS must contain no scroll/wheel/touch listeners, no IntersectionObserver, no getBoundingClientRect — the validator's runtime instrumentation enforces this; write clean code, not grep-dodging code. 5+ steps, visibly different groupings (screenshot-hash distinct). Real prose ≥25 words/step.
tickets.acceptance:
- `node test/validate-story.mjs examples/dots-flow.html` → exit 0, glueTier=tier2, stepCount>=5, distinctGraphicStates>=5, bidirectionalConsistent (includes the validator's non-monotonic traversal — this catches accumulator cheats)
- determinism: two fresh page loads, screenshot hash of the initial story state identical (in verify)
- purity probe (in verify): navigate a→c→b vs reload-then-b; step-b screenshot hashes match
- `bun test` green
tickets.evidence: Verify: verified=true clean. Gate + spot-check: exit 0 glueTier=tier2, 6 steps, bidirectional+non-monotonic ok; mulberry32 seed 1337 determinism + purity probe (a->c->b == reload->b) passed. Merge 10f925e.

tickets.title: Tier-2 example: continuous scroll-linked motion via --step-progress, overlay layout (R2D3 choreography)
tickets.origin: SPEC §14 Tier 2 (R2D3 2015) + §6.1 overlay coverage; sharpened per red-team (ledger [0004])
tickets.context: Read README.md (custom properties), docs/recipes.md (parallax/progress), SPEC.md §5.2. Single self-contained page, data-layout="overlay": full-bleed inline-SVG scene with TWO INDEPENDENTLY-PARAMETERIZED elements moving continuously within chapters — pure CSS transforms via calc(var(--step-progress) * ...) with DIFFERENT coefficients/axes (e.g. a boundary line rotating while points translate). Smooth motion, no steps() easing. Discrete data-show swaps between chapters as well. Steps are overlay cards; set --scrolly-card-bg/-fg for readable contrast. Target ZERO author JS beyond Scrolly.init() (tier1) — all continuous motion must be pure CSS. 5+ steps, real prose ≥25 words/step.
tickets.acceptance:

- continuous motion (in verify): sample computed transform of BOTH driven elements at 20/40/60/80% of one chapter — four distinct values each, consecutive deltas within 3× of each other (rules out steps()/threshold fakes), total travel ≥8px translate or ≥5deg rotate per element, and the two elements' transform sequences are not identical

- overlay cards: computed background-color of .step > * is non-transparent at widths 400, 600, and 719

tickets.title: dist/ packaging: ESM + IIFE + minified builds, behaviorally equivalent, deterministic

tickets.context: Read SPEC.md §9 and oracle locked decisions ('dist builds are ADDITIVE — src never modularized'). Add esbuild as devDependency. scripts/build.mjs: ALWAYS deletes and regenerates dist/ (no skip-if-exists), no timestamps/dates anywhere in output. Emit: (1) dist/scrolly.iife.js = src/scrolly.js verbatim; (2) dist/scrolly.min.js = esbuild-minified; (3) dist/scrolly.esm.js = `const window = globalThis;` + IIFE source + `export default globalThis.Scrolly` (or equivalent that works under bun import AND <script type=module> in a browser). package.json: "build" script + exports entries for ./dist/*. test/dist.test.js asserts the full Phase C oracle INCLUDING behavioral parity for ALL THREE builds: for each of esm (via type=module page), iife, and min, a fixture page (reuse test/fixture.html geometry with the script swapped) must activate step 'a' at scrollY=1700 under puppeteer. DO NOT touch src/.

tickets.title: Two typography themes (structural-CSS-free, full element coverage) + swap proof
tickets.origin: SPEC §12 v1.0 themes + §2.4; sharpened per red-team (ledger [0004])
tickets.context: Read SPEC.md §2.4/§6 and src/scrolly.css (themes must not restate ANY lib rule). Two opt-in stylesheets, system font stacks only (self-contained: no @font-face files, no @import, no url()): themes/editorial.css — serif display stack (font-family must include a serif token), warm palette, generous measure; themes/system.css — system-ui stack, tight, neutral. Each theme MUST style all of: .step h1-h4, .step p, figure captions (figcaption or .caption), and set --scrolly-card-bg/-fg. Allowed properties: font-*, line-height, letter-spacing, color, background-color, text-* (incl. text-overflow), max-width/padding on step content blocks. FORBIDDEN (grep-enforced): position, sticky, display, grid, flex, height, min-height, z-index, transform, isolation, overflow (bare/x/y — text-overflow is fine), and ALL at-rules except none (no @media, @container, @supports, @import, @font-face). test/themes.test.js: (1) forbidden-token scan on both files (regex must allowlist text-overflow); (2) semantic check: editorial font-family contains 'serif' token, system contains 'system-ui'; (3) behavioral: load index.html with theme <link> injected AFTER the lib stylesheet vs without — computed font-family of a .step h2, a .step p, AND color of a figure caption each DIFFER across loads; computed position of the figure ('sticky') IDENTICAL across loads.
tickets.acceptance:
- forbidden-token scan green on both theme files (list above, text-overflow allowlisted)
- editorial.css has a serif-family token; system.css has system-ui; the two files' font stacks differ
- puppeteer: h2 font-family, p font-family, and caption color all differ with/without theme; figure position identical; theme link injected after lib CSS
- `bun test` green
tickets.evidence: Independent verify: verified=true, clean scope, no gaming. Coordinator gate: themes.test.js 15 tests green within 45-green merged suite (forbidden-token scan, serif vs system-ui, behavioral swap proof, figure sticky identical). Commit d057805 (merge of ticket/S108 8f06f12).
